w2: Planning a wedding usually means a dozen lists, spreadsheets and group texts. The Wedding Desk puts your tasks, guests, money and vendors in one place, and handles the small stuff for you.
a1: To begin, create your account. Add your name, your email, and a password.
a2: Choose your role, then tap Start Our Wedding.
x1: Already planning in Excel? Open Settings, and tap Import from Excel.
x2: Pick your file, and everything comes right into the app. You're off to a fast start.
x3: Starting new instead? Just add your names, date and venue in Settings.
h1: Home shows what needs your attention this week, plus your guests, budget and progress.
h2: Scroll down when you want more detail.
p1: Plan is your to-do list, grouped by month. Tap Add to create a task, and choose who owns it.
p2: When it's done, tap the circle to check it off.
d1: Decisions takes you through the big questions, one at a time.
d2: Type your answer, mark it Decided, and the next step becomes a task for you.
s1: Schedule lays out the wedding day, minute by minute, with who's in charge and the music.
g1: Guests is everyone you're inviting. Tap Add to bring someone in.
g2: Tap any guest to call, text, email or get directions. Messages come already written.
r1: Still waiting on replies? Tap Text or Email, then tap each name. Every guest gets a message made just for them.
r2: As replies come in, mark them here, and your counts update.
m1: Money shows your budget, what's booked and what's paid.
m2: Tap Mark Paid when a payment is made, and every total updates.
v1: Vendors tracks every vendor, from the first call to the signed contract.
v2: Mark a contract signed, and a deposit reminder is added for you.
sh1: Need to share a list? Tap Share, and choose who it's for.
sh2: Then save it as a PDF, print it, or paste it into a text.
i1: Planning with someone? Open Settings, and tap Invite Someone.
i2: Choose what they can do, then send them the code. They'll see the same plan you do.
k1: The Wedding Desk is on your computer too. Sign in, and the same plan is there on a bigger screen.
o1: That's The Wedding Desk. Help is always one tap away. Happy planning!
